stem: How did the federal government respond to the 1963 march described in this excerpt?
instruction: Read the excerpt and answer the question that follows.

options.label: A
options.text: By passing legislation prohibiting discrimination in public places

options.label: B
options.text: By signing an executive order to desegregate the military

options.label: C
options.text: By asking the Supreme Court to rule segregation of schools unconstitutional

options.label: D
options.text: By ratifying an amendment granting suffrage to people of all races

visual_elements: The March on Washington for Jobs and Freedom brought together the nation’s most prominent civil rights leaders, along with tens of thousands of marchers, to press the United States government for equality. The culmination of this event was the influential and most memorable speech of Dr. King’s career. —“Martin Luther King, Jr.,” National Archives and Records Administration, www.archives.gov (accessed October 5, 2017)
